title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Savor the flavors of the Middle East with this classic dish featuring succulent lamb kebabs grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
